name: hou_mcp_architecture_realize
description: Tier 10.5 — Realize architectural features to Houdini geometry. Accepts plan_json from hou_mcp_architectural_features and creates actual Houdini geometry nodes: /obj/sh_door_opening_*, /obj/sh_window_opening_*, /obj/sh_beam_*, /obj/sh_fireplace_*, /obj/sh_shelf_*. This is the ONLY Tier 10.5 node that calls the Houdini bridge. The ARCHITECTURE_STATUS from hou_mcp_architectural_features must be PASS before calling this node.
